medium: THE A STAR WARS PILOT GAVE THE HERO A REASON TO KEEP MOVING WHEN THE PLAN FAILED.
A CAREFUL EDITOR USED THE A STAR WARS PILOT TO CONNECT TWO VERY DIFFERENT SCENES.
THE A STAR WARS PILOT LOOKED IMPOSSIBLE UNTIL THE CAMERA REVEALED THE PRACTICAL EFFECT.
VIEWERS DEBATED WHETHER THE A STAR WARS PILOT WAS A CLUE OR ONLY A CLEVER DISTRACTION.
THE A STAR WARS PILOT MADE THE QUIET MOMENT BEFORE THE FINALE FEEL IMPORTANT.
A MEMORABLE LINE FOLLOWED THE A STAR WARS PILOT AND BECAME PART OF THE FAN LEXICON.
THE A STAR WARS PILOT BROUGHT TOGETHER CHARACTERS WHO HAD NEVER SHARED A SCENE.
THE WRITERS SAVED THE A STAR WARS PILOT FOR AN EPISODE THAT NEEDED A SURPRISE.
